name: fac-workshop-agenda
description: Designs the agenda for a working session where the group must produce or decide something, producing blocks marked diverge or converge, the exercise and group split for each block, and a participant version plus a facilitator version. Use for "run fac-workshop-agenda", "workshop agenda", "build the workshop agenda", "help me structure a three hour session", "what exercises should we run", "the agenda is a list of topics", "design a decision workshop", "offsite agenda", part of the Claude for Trainers and Facilitators Pack by 90n.
